findings.highlight: She shouldn’t know the proper etiquette
findings.evidenceJa: 作法を知らないというのに
findings.governingReading: Shirou admires Illya’s elegance even though she does not know the local etiquette.
findings.explanation: The English changes an observed lack of knowledge into the narrator’s expectation that she should not know.

findings.highlight: she wants Tohsaka to like her
findings.evidenceJa: 好きになって欲しいと思っている筈だ
findings.governingReading: Shirou infers that Sakura must want Rin to love her in return.
findings.explanation: The English removes his explicit epistemic qualification.

findings.highlight: a silence that even gets us nervous
findings.evidenceJa: 見ているこっちの方が息苦しくなる沈黙
findings.governingReading: The sisters’ silence is so oppressive that Shirou, merely watching, feels short of breath.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the experiencer and replaces the bodily oppression with generic nervousness.

findings.evidenceJa: 普段は人の事情なんてお構いなし
findings.governingReading: Shirou says Rin normally pays no heed to other people’s circumstances.
findings.explanation: The English replaces interpersonal disregard with dominance, changing the trait under discussion.

findings.highlight: It’s obvious that you really want to call her that
findings.evidenceJa: ホントはそう呼びたいクセに無理してる
findings.governingReading: Shirou says it is obvious Sakura wants to call Rin Nee-san but is forcing herself not to.
findings.explanation: The English preserves the wish but omits her deliberate emotional restraint.

findings.evidenceJa: 内気で、恥ずかしがり屋で、姉思いの妹
findings.governingReading: Shirou realizes Sakura is more introverted, bashful, and devoted to her elder sister than he had thought.
findings.explanation: The English compresses three character traits into a vague reserve concerning Rin’s feelings.

findings.governingReading: Shirou refers to the relationship between an elder sister and a younger sister.
findings.explanation: The English produces malformed possessive phrasing and obscures the reciprocal sibling relation.

findings.highlight: there’s nothing more important than that
findings.evidenceJa: それ以上に確かな関係なんてない
findings.governingReading: Shirou says there is no relationship more certain or dependable than Sakura loving Rin and Rin being her sister.
findings.explanation: The English changes certainty and security into comparative importance.

findings.governingReading: Sakura visibly steels herself and summons resolve before heading to the kitchen.
findings.explanation: The English invents a breath and removes the compact physical show of determination.

findings.evidenceJa: レタスをちぎってください
findings.governingReading: Sakura asks Rin to tear the lettuce by hand.
findings.explanation: The English changes the preparation technique to cutting.

findings.evidenceJa: 呆れた風にイリヤは言う
findings.governingReading: Illya speaks with an exasperated or fed-up air.
findings.explanation: The English changes weary exasperation into astonished incomprehension.
